sections.title: What's new
whats_new: Picture to Item — read visible item-card details on this PC, compare known matches, and review a reconstruction before using it.
Item names — Builds and cards show full in-game names, including prefixes and class-mod passives.
Builds — inspect parts, validate the finished item, preview its card, then send the same item to yourself or the lobby.
Co-op sending — large guest item lists are split into steady, auto-opened reward packages.
Missions — dedicated progress controls, with optional missions in MAX ALL and Auto Lobby.
Saved item lists — your existing lists appear automatically under Builds.

sections.warning: Host only. Useful for timed boosts, but stacking UVHM + challenges + auto-drop items on a full lobby can still hitch. Prefer one heavy job at a time. Uses the Boost target in the bar under the tabs.

fields.label: How to give items

option_labels.mail: Mail to guests once per join
option_labels.both: Drop on timer + mail once per join

fields.tooltip: Drop = codes → host mail → open → spill backpack (repeats on timer). Mail = copy codes to each guest once when they join (never empties Builds). Both = timed ground pile AND once-per-join guest mail.

fields.tooltip: Off (recommended for boosting lobbies): only joined guests get mail. On: host also gets one mail pack when Auto Lobby starts (in addition to guests).

fields.label: Drop source (when not using a list name below)
fields.tooltip: Used for the ground pile when Drop list name is blank. For two Builds (drop + mail), pick Both above and type both names — this can stay on Random codes.

fields.label: Codes listing
fields.tooltip: Only used when ground drop comes from random GZO / Lootlemon codes.

fields.label: DROP — Item list
fields.tooltip: Pick which Item list to spill on the ground (Drop / Both). Copies only — never removes codes. Blank = use Drop source / GZO above.

fields.label: MAIL — Item list
fields.tooltip: Pick which Item list to mail to guests (Mail / Both). Different from DROP = drop one pack, mail another. Same name = drop and mail that list. Blank = reuse drop / GZO. Always copies — list stays intact.

fields.label: How many items each cycle
fields.tooltip: How many codes per auto-items pass. Shaped drops cap around the coop pin budget (~180). Needs backpack space for Drop (use Set backpack + bank size).

fields.label: Again every (seconds)
fields.tooltip: Minimum gap between auto-item passes. First pass also fires during the post-boost rest.

fields.label: Auto clear world loot (everyone)
fields.tooltip: Own timer (independent of Auto items). Clears shapes + ground loot for the whole lobby so piles do not stack for hours.

fields.label: Clear loot every (seconds)
fields.tooltip: Separate from Auto items interval. Default 5 minutes.

fields.label: Kick guests after a boost cycle
fields.tooltip: Starts a per-guest countdown after a cycle finishes, then kicks. Use “Only kick after full run” (recommended) so late joiners are not kicked early.

fields.label: Only kick guests who finished a full boost cycle
fields.tooltip: ON (recommended for lobbies): guest must finish every selected job this join (MAX ALL, challenges, mail, …) before a kick timer arms. Late joiners wait until they get a complete run. OFF: anyone still in the lobby when a cycle ends can be kicked after the timer.

fields.label: Kick delay (seconds)
fields.tooltip: Base time after they earn a kick slot when no mail-only run (default 3 min).

fields.label: Kick delay after mail (seconds)
fields.tooltip: Used when this run mailed serials (Reward Center) and did not drop ground loot. Default 90s — shorter than the loot pickup bonus.

fields.label: Extra kick time if ground loot ran (seconds)
fields.tooltip: Added when Drop All Shinies or auto ground-drop ran this session (default +4 min).

fields.tooltip: Pick a lobby guest and Add — they stay on this list until Remove. Auto kick skips them even after they leave and rejoin (SHiFT / platform name match).
